Ordinal box probabilities by adaptive Gauss-Hermite quadrature

Source: R/conditionalDesignCopula.R
box_prob_quadrature.Rd

For each column \(k\), \(\log P(lower < m + l u + e \le upper)\) with \(u \sim N(0, 1)\) and \(e \sim N(0, I)\) independent: \(\log \int \prod_j P_j(u) \phi(u) du\), where \(P_j\) is a univariate normal probability. The integrand is log-concave in \(u\); Newton's method finds its mode and the curvature there, which place an n_nodes-point Gauss-Hermite rule, all columns at once. With 20 nodes the relative error was below \(10^{-5}\) in every check.

Usage

box_prob_quadrature(m, lower, upper, l, n_nodes = 20)

Arguments

m, lower, upper

Matrices, one row per ordinal observation and one column per evaluation.

l

Output of latent_factor().

n_nodes

Number of quadrature nodes.

Value

A vector of log probabilities.
